title: Int8 weight-only compact profile smoke + regression orchestration and calibration runbook
creator: Asha Raman
description: Integrate compact INT8 weight-only profiles for GPTQ/AWQ into CI and create an orchestrated regression harness and calibration runbook. Goal is to validate accuracy and stability across workloads and hardware variants, detect calibration drift, and provide clear rollback and remediation steps for any detected regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Smoke CI job runs on every model profile PR and completes within 45m on dedicated test pool
Regression suite (nightly) executes against 6 representative models and reports pass/fail with diffs and token-level error traces
Calibration workflow produces a stable INT8 profile artifact and stores per-batch stats in metrics store
Performance counters show <5% median latency regression vs FP16 baseline for canonical prompts across test matrix
Rollback playbook validated in staging: automatic fallback to compatible FP16/GPTQ variant within 2 minutes
test_matrix: Models: 7B, 13B open-architecture models (two variants each), one internal 34B smoke model
Hardware: A100-40GB, H100-80GB, RTX6000 (dev pool) to capture kernel selection differences
Quant methods: GPTQ (per-channel), AWQ (activation-aware), both weight-only conversion paths
Metrics: Perplexity delta on eval set, exact-match and recall on regression prompt sets, token-level logit diff distributions, latency P50/P95, token cost
calibration_workflow: 1) Produce baseline FP16 eval artifacts using canonical eval-suite (scripts/eval/run_baseline.sh)
2) Run GPTQ and AWQ weight-only conversion with calibration dataset sampled from production prompt corpus (1M tokens sample), store calibration traces
3) Compute calibration statistics (per-channel scale/zero points, activation histograms) and persist to s3://redwood-quant/calibration/ENG-15890/
4) Run accuracy checks comparing quantized output to baseline with configured tolerances; if drift > threshold, mark profile as failed
5) If passed, publish profile artifact with semantic version and metadata (model-hash, dataset-hash, quant-method, seed, compile flags)
6) Trigger canary rollout to dedicated dev fleet for long-run stability (48h), with continuous drift detection
regression_orchestration: Define CI jobs: int8-smoke (PR gate), int8-nightly-regression (nightly matrix), int8-longrun (48h canary)
Orchestrator: use existing runner pool tagged 'quant-ci' and k8s job templates in infra/ci/quant/
Result aggregation: upload evaluation artifacts and token-level diffs to perf-dashboard / dashboards/quant-profiles/eng-15890
Alerting: on failure, create regression incident, notify #quantization-alerts, and open ENG incident tracker with prefilled template
Auto-bisect: for nightly failures attempt binary search across recent PRs and calibration seeds to propose likely culprits
rollback_playbook: If canary shows >3% perplexity regression or production error rate increases by 1%:
1) Pin routing policy to previous known-good profile (runtime route override) and scale canary down
2) Re-classify failing profile artifact as deprecated and add 'rollback' tag
3) Notify customers on affected SLAs and record in incident timeline
4) Start root cause: reproduce locally with the saved calibration traces and run variant comparisons (FP16 vs GPTQ vs AWQ)
5) If necessary, revert CI gate to require additional review for subsequent profile PRs
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Calibration dataset drift leads to silent accuracy regressions; Mitigation: add sliding-window sampling and drift detector that re-triggers calibration when KL divergence exceeds threshold
Risk: Kernel instability on certain GPUs causing rare flakiness; Mitigation: expand smoke hardware matrix and add kernel-version tagging for repro
Risk: Cost/time of nightly full-matrix runs; Mitigation: implement smart sampling and historical-failure prioritization to reduce runs to ~40% when stable
